cacheNote: Local judgment cache is never read. cold-no-judgment-cache = first/isolated process; warm-immediate-repeat = consecutive live run (provider warmth only; still no persisted judgment reads).

config.adapter: Compact fixture prompts in recorded order, first/last response only; counts/tools in summary (not full fixture JSON); no fabricated tools or timestamps. Results apply to these redacted fixtures.
